metadata.description: Azure Architecture Diagram Builder — MCP Usage Monitor workbook. Reads the MCP server's per-request usage log (event 'mcp_request') from the Container Apps Log Analytics workspace. Generated by scripts/build-mcp-usage-workbook.py.
Application Insights component whose workbook gallery hosts this workbook (same as the LLM Cost Monitor).
Full resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace that receives the Container Apps console logs.
Stable GUID so re-deploys update the same workbook.

content.json:
## 🔌 MCP Usage Monitor
Who is using the **Azure Architecture Diagram Builder MCP server**, from which clients, which tools they call, and whether sign-in and tool calls succeed.

Source: one JSON log line per request to the remote MCP endpoint (`event: mcp_request`) in the Container Apps Log Analytics workspace. Records carry the caller's **tenant ID and Entra object ID only** — no names, emails, tokens or tool arguments. To see who an object ID is, run `az ad user show --id <objectId>` in the server's tenant. Rejected requests (401/403) carry no identity; use the user agent to group them.

content.query:
let McpRequests = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "azure-diagram-mcp"
| where Log_s startswith "{" and Log_s has "\"mcp_request\""
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| project TimeGenerated, Status = toint(r.status), DurationMs = toint(r.durationMs),
    Auth = tostring(r.auth), AuthError = tostring(r.authError),
    TenantId = tostring(r.tenantId), ObjectId = tostring(r.objectId),
    ClientName = tostring(r.clientName), ClientVersion = tostring(r.clientVersion),
    UserAgent = tostring(r.userAgent), RpcMethods = r.rpcMethods, Tools = r.tools,
    ToolResults = r.toolResults, Revision = tostring(r.revision);
McpRequests
| summarize ['Requests'] = count(), ['Successful (2xx)'] = countif(Status between (200 .. 299)),
    ['Auth rejected'] = countif(Auth == 'rejected'), ['Entra users'] = dcountif(ObjectId, Auth == 'entra' and isnotempty(ObjectId)),
    ['Tool calls'] = countif(array_length(Tools) > 0)
| evaluate narrow()
| project Metric = Column, Value = toint(Value)
content.title: At a glance

content.query:
let McpRequests = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "azure-diagram-mcp"
| where Log_s startswith "{" and Log_s has "\"mcp_request\""
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| project TimeGenerated, Status = toint(r.status), DurationMs = toint(r.durationMs),
    Auth = tostring(r.auth), AuthError = tostring(r.authError),
    TenantId = tostring(r.tenantId), ObjectId = tostring(r.objectId),
    ClientName = tostring(r.clientName), ClientVersion = tostring(r.clientVersion),
    UserAgent = tostring(r.userAgent), RpcMethods = r.rpcMethods, Tools = r.tools,
    ToolResults = r.toolResults, Revision = tostring(r.revision);
McpRequests
| extend Outcome = case(Auth == 'rejected', 'Auth rejected', Status between (200 .. 299), 'Successful', 'Other error')
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Outcome
content.title: Requests per day by outcome

content.query:
let McpRequests = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "azure-diagram-mcp"
| where Log_s startswith "{" and Log_s has "\"mcp_request\""
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| project TimeGenerated, Status = toint(r.status), DurationMs = toint(r.durationMs),
    Auth = tostring(r.auth), AuthError = tostring(r.authError),
    TenantId = tostring(r.tenantId), ObjectId = tostring(r.objectId),
    ClientName = tostring(r.clientName), ClientVersion = tostring(r.clientVersion),
    UserAgent = tostring(r.userAgent), RpcMethods = r.rpcMethods, Tools = r.tools,
    ToolResults = r.toolResults, Revision = tostring(r.revision);
McpRequests
| where Auth == 'entra'
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(),
    ToolCalls = countif(array_length(Tools) > 0), Clients = make_set_if(strcat(ClientName, ' ', ClientVersion), isnotempty(ClientName)),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5) by TenantId, ObjectId
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Users (Entra sign-ins)

content.query:
let McpRequests = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "azure-diagram-mcp"
| where Log_s startswith "{" and Log_s has "\"mcp_request\""
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| project TimeGenerated, Status = toint(r.status), DurationMs = toint(r.durationMs),
    Auth = tostring(r.auth), AuthError = tostring(r.authError),
    TenantId = tostring(r.tenantId), ObjectId = tostring(r.objectId),
    ClientName = tostring(r.clientName), ClientVersion = tostring(r.clientVersion),
    UserAgent = tostring(r.userAgent), RpcMethods = r.rpcMethods, Tools = r.tools,
    ToolResults = r.toolResults, Revision = tostring(r.revision);
McpRequests
| mv-expand T = ToolResults
| where isnotempty(T)
| summarize Calls = count(), Failures = countif(tobool(T.ok) == false), Users = dcount(ObjectId),
    P50Ms = percentile(toint(T.durationMs), 50), P95Ms = percentile(toint(T.durationMs), 95),
    LastError = take_anyif(tostring(T.error), tobool(T.ok) == false) by Tool = tostring(T.tool)
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failures / Calls, 1)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Tool usage and failure rate

| project TimeGenerated, Tool = tostring(T.tool), Error = tostring(T.error), DurationMs = toint(T.durationMs), Auth, TenantId, ObjectId, ClientName
